review_notes: I read the whole file and the glue-data definitions in Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean. I grepped the repo for other copies of fstDiv_add, sndDiv_add and glueData_add. The file has no local @[simp] attributes of its own. The only simp-interface issue I found is that the additivity lemmas for fstDiv, sndDiv and glueData are missing from the definitions file. This file therefore reproves them as private lemmas and applies them by manual rw/show. I did not run Lean, so I make no claim about simp behaviour. Whether simp would close each step is untested, and orientation and termination look unproblematic because the rewrite is a standard push-through of +. I did not check whether the maxHeartbeats settings relate to simp-set problems.

findings.problem: The definitions file Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean states only `fstDiv_zero`, `sndDiv_zero` and `glueData_zero`, and none of them carries @[simp]. It states no additivity lemmas for `fstDiv`, `sndDiv` or `glueData`. This file therefore reproves `fstDiv_add` and `sndDiv_add` as private lemmas. Other solution files in the repo reprove the same lemmas, and one also proves `glueData_add`. Because no canonical simp rules exist, the proofs here are manual. `hglue` in `solution` uses `show Finsupp.mapDomain ... (P.fstDiv (↑Dab + ↑Dt)) = _`, then `rw [fstDiv_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add]; rfl`, plus a separate `show (0 : ...) = 0 + 0`. `IsGoodLift.add` uses the same rw chain. A `glueData_add` lemma would replace the whole `hglue` block. A `simp` call cannot push `fstDiv`/`sndDiv`/`glueData` through `+` or `0` here, because the lemmas are private and not tagged.
findings.proposed_change: Move `fstDiv_add`, `sndDiv_add` and `glueData_add` into Def_ModularCurve_GlueData.lean, next to `fstDiv_zero`. Tag them, and the existing `fstDiv_zero`, `sndDiv_zero` and `glueData_zero`, with @[simp]. The orientation `P.fstDiv (D + D') = P.fstDiv D + P.fstDiv D'` pushes the function inward and terminates, as `map_add` does. Then delete the private copies here. In `solution`, replace the `hglue` block with `glueData_add`. In `IsGoodLift.add`, use `simp only [fstDiv_add, Finsupp.mapDomain_add, h1, h1']` or keep the rw.
findings.benefit: There is a single canonical, discoverable normal form for the additive structure of the glue data. Several files no longer carry duplicate private proofs. Proofs like `hglue` become one-line rewrites instead of `show ... ; rfl` unfoldings that depend on the definitional shape of `glueData`.
